notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud PWA site. Direct HTTP egress to surlatable.com was blocked at the network layer from this host (TCP connect timeout to all Cloudflare/AWS IPs, and WebFetch returned nothing), so every page was retrieved server-side through the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which renders the React listing pages. Category tree taken from https://www.surlatable.com/sitemap_0.xml (/products/... branch). Every qty is the site's own listing-header count ('N Items'), cross-checked against the pagination footer 'Showing X of N' on the same page - the two agreed on all 27 rows. Cookware, bakeware, knives, kitchen tools, small appliances, food, flatware/cutlery, linens/textiles, cleaning, storage and personal care were excluded per brief. Brand pages (e.g. /dining-bar/brands/riedel) and 'Dinnerware Collections' / 'Glassware Collections' / 'Flatware Collections' pages were skipped as brand and collection navigation, not categories. 'Wreaths & Trees' (/products/kitchen-decor/decor/wreaths-trees/) reported '0 Items' and was dropped. Deduped: /products/dining-bar/decor/* and /products/kitchen-decor/decor/* are the same category (identical breadcrumb 'Kitchen & Decor > Decor' and identical counts) - kept the kitchen-decor URLs; 'Sugar Bowls & Creamers' also appears at /products/kitchen-decor/countertop-organization/sugar-bowls-creamers/ with the same 6 items - kept one. The parent pages 'Decor' (76) and 'Fragrance Collection' (64) were omitted: 'Decor' returns exactly the same 76 as its 'Home Decor' child, and 'Fragrance Collection' mixes in soaps & lotions (personal care).
